heard-about-me: the pure reliability / confidence / mishearing rules
heard-about-me: a FALSE claim misdirects a nomination (falsifiable)
heard-about-me: through the MCP boundary (the four-place rule)
heard-about-me: Vault sentinel across memory, prompt, npcVoice and getGameState
the teller's reliability is the listener's trust in them (clamped), plus a bonus when the listener credits them as a word-keeper
the confidence is monotone in the teller's reliability and bounded to [floor, ceiling]
a tell is misheard below a roll threshold that SHRINKS with reliability, never above the configured bound; a fully reliable teller is never misheard
a tell writes a targets-me claim for the listener ONLY: origin told, source the teller, the tilt reads it
the claim's confidence is the TELLER's reliability: a trusted teller lands harder than a distrusted one
a betrayal tell writes a heard-rumor claim (nature betrayal) the nomination belief read also folds in
the same tell twice in a week is one claim (idempotent), and writes no edge fold and no memory entry
nobody is actually targeting the HOH, yet after a tell that the player is, the HOH puts the PLAYER up; with no tell (or flag off) they do not
a MISHEARD tell (some tells, by construction) lands on an innocent houseguest and misdirects the nomination onto THEM
mishearing is seeded and bounded: deterministic per game, and over every (teller, listener) pair of a distrusted house the rate sits under the configured bound (most tells are faithful)
one listener's heard claim never shows in another houseguest's store or read (not a non-listener, not the teller, not the player)
two listeners of one tell each hold their OWN claim, at their OWN trust in the teller
the player as the 'teller', a scene with no other NPC to hear it, a missing / unknown `from`, and an unknown nature each write nothing
a teller who is not a named witness of the scene, and the writer called directly with the player (or the listener) as teller, write nothing
with the belief layer OFF nothing is written even with the heard flag on
the tell writes nothing for a houseguest who is not a NAMED witness of the scene
recordInteraction carrying heardAboutMe writes the claim; a malformed descriptor is refused with the field name
flag unset == flag explicitly off, whole snapshot; and no heard claim exists
flag on changes ONLY the belief store: edges, ledger, events and every other field are identical (no rng, no fold)
the flag is registered strict (on only when exactly '1')
no hidden datum reaches a claim or any outward projection, and no claim carries free text
only a visibly RATTLED tell invites a reaction (never giddy / warm-open / guarded / restless)
a warm bond comforts; cunning without a warm bond exploits; a cold bond avoids a snapping tell; otherwise nothing
the observer's PERSONALITY, not the bond alone, decides: same cool bond, cunning exploits and tender comforts
seeded and band-scaled: a stronger tell is reacted to at a higher roll; monotone in the roll
exploit tilt is bounded and decays to zero
